==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''He'mu:''' Hey, see that big peach tree over there? That's the symbol of Taoyuan Vale.
:'''He'mu:''' Flowers can be brewed into flower wine, and fruits can be picked and made into fruit preserves...
:{{DIcon}} Keep talking about food, aren't you?
:'''He'mu:''' ...Ahem, there's more to it!
:'''He'mu:''' The famous Liondancer [[Lingyang]] from the city comes to Taoyuan Vale every year for secluded training!
:'''He'mu:''' Peach blossoms fluttering down, lions dancing with the wind... Nothing is more beautiful than this.
{{Dialogue End}}
